Identify the affected study area, select an appropriate Earth observation dataset for mapping burn scars, retrieve data covering the region, and explain why the chosen dataset is suitable and how it relates to the narrative.
tasks.reference_solution_description: Search EO Dashboard for the Australian bushfires narrative, geocode New South Wales, Australia (the region most affected), then download the MODIS Burned Area product (MCD64A1, 500 m) via GEE — its wide swath and burn-date band suit a state-scale fire assessment better than a single 10 m Sentinel-2 tile. tasks.reference_solution_description: Search EO Dashboard for real climate-change narratives via keyword 'climate'. In the EOSS ontology, none of the 16 real StrategicObjective nodes mention adaptation at all (they're programme-management objectives — frontier science, partnerships, AI — not topical ones), so querying that node type returns nothing. The real adaptation link lives on the ScienceQuestion→Treaty relationship: 4 ScienceQuestion nodes (SQ-02 Land biosphere responses, SQ-05 Coastal sea level, SQ-20 Ice mass balance, SQ-44 Water cycle) have an INFORMS edge to the Paris Agreement (PARIS) whose 'detail' property literally mentions 'adaptation' (Art 7). Each of those ScienceQuestions HAS_KAO relationships to real KnowledgeAdvancementObjective nodes — the ontology's actual 'objective' entities. SQ-44 (Water cycle) and its KAOs (e.g. 'Quantify anthropogenic forcing of water availability') align most closely with the water-themed narratives found in step 1.

steps.comment: Find the two real climate-change narratives (both oceans-themed, both about water resources)

arguments.cypher: MATCH (sq:ScienceQuestion)-[r:INFORMS]->(t:Treaty {id:'PARIS'}) WHERE toLower(r.detail) CONTAINS 'adapt' MATCH (sq)-[:HAS_KAO]->(kao:KnowledgeAdvancementObjective) RETURN sq.id, sq.name, kao.id, kao.name

steps.comment: StrategicObjective nodes never mention adaptation in this ontology — the real adaptation link is the INFORMS edge from ScienceQuestion to the Paris Agreement (Art 7), so traverse from there to each ScienceQuestion's KnowledgeAdvancementObjective nodes, the ontology's actual 'objective' entities
